source: redactSecretsInLog/fixtureBodyRedactFields do not gate the event log (src/log_entry.rs, src/recorded.rs). Both are startup-only on the real oracle (PUT /mockserver/configuration does not make them take effect), so this scenario needs its own server, started with them set. This adopts upstream c76143e4a and cc7d7d185 (upstream commits adopted after 8.0.0): the steps marked "diverge" check our fixed answer; the goldens keep 8.0.0's.

steps.note: default sensitive headers (Authorization, Cookie), a default sensitive query parameter (key) and two configured body fields, one nested; an unconfigured header/query/body field stays
REQUESTS JSON: headers, query and configured body fields redacted; the body collapses to a plain string
REQUESTS JAVA (ordered form): the same redaction
REQUESTS CURL: the redacted header, not the real one
REQUESTS LOG_ENTRIES: the 8.0.0 oracle redacts the top-level httpRequest only, message and arguments keep the raw request; upstream c76143e4a/cc7d7d185 (adopted, diverge) redact them too
REQUEST_RESPONSES JSON: response header and body field redacted too
REQUEST_RESPONSES LOG_ENTRIES: same top-level-only redaction as REQUESTS
plain-text LOGS: the 8.0.0 oracle never redacts it (the golden holds the raw values); upstream c76143e4a (adopted, diverge) redacts every request, response and expectation in it
LOGS LOG_ENTRIES: the 8.0.0 oracle redacts the RECEIVED_REQUEST entry's httpRequest only; adopted upstream cc7d7d185 redacts its message and arguments too (diverge)
